title: Total-Loss Replacement Credit on Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Addenda
content:
# Total-Loss Replacement Credit

A Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans earns a total-loss replacement credit according to the total-loss cancellation entry of one particular plan.

**Which plan is read.** The plan read is the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan named on the customer's most recent signed total-loss cancellation request. Most recent means by request date, and on the same date by the time the request was registered.

**What is read.** That plan's total-loss cancellation entry, by its date, measured back from the pricing date (the day the addendum is signed):

| Date of that total-loss cancellation entry | Total-loss replacement credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 1 whole month before the pricing date | 60.00 |
| 1 or more, but fewer than 3, whole months before | 30.00 |
| 3 or more whole months before, or no such entry | None |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, pricing date 10 August)
| Entry date | Whole months back | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 11 July | 0 | 60.00 |
| 10 July | 1 | 30.00 |
| 11 May | 2 | 30.00 |
| 10 May | 3 | none |
| The named plan carries no total-loss cancellation entry | — | none |

Two total-loss requests signed on the same date are ordered by the time each request was registered. The later-registered request names the plan read.
